summary_requirements: Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Primary workloads: conversational product assistant (latency-sensitive), semantic search and reranking for recommendations. Target P95 latency for chat responses 150-300ms; throughput target ~20-40 QPS for peak routes. Cost sensitive — want to validate per-1000-token unit economics. Prefer open models but need fallbacks (cheaper quantized variants) for scale. Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS-managed keys, and US data residency for a subset of customer data.
